failureClasses.meaning: The base has no append-only event-ledger schema, transition table, reducer, durable append, or recovery implementation.
The base gate validates an allowed status enum and stage receipt snapshot but does not bind dag.json projection fields to replayed ledger history.
The base still accepts implementing, review, verifying, deliverable, and delivered as independently editable node states.

knownExistingBehaviorThatCannotStartRed.evidence: .agents/skills/issue-orchestration/scripts/validate-state-root.mjs already rejects protected-root overlap and symlink escapes; R05/R06 retain it as a non-regression and integrate ledger path authority.

.agents/skills/issue-orchestration/scripts/check-dag-gate.mjs already rejects several role/receipt conflicts; the new controls tighten them around append authority and the latest candidate-green contract.
